name: com.gameframex.unity.advertisement.topon
description:
GameFrameX Advertisement TopOn — TopOn ad aggregation adapter for GameFrameX Advertisement on Android and iOS. Implements BaseAdvertisementManager as TopOnAdvertisementManager supporting banner, interstitial, rewarded video and native ads, with complete ad event callbacks, built-in error handling and retry. TopOnAdvertisementBootstrap self-registers the channel into AdvertisementRegistry at BeforeSceneLoad and injects strongly typed config (per-platform appId/appKey plus adUnitId); native bridge callbacks are handled by TopOnAdvertisementBridgeLink. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX Advertisement TopOn — GameFrameX 广告组件的 TopOn 聚合广告渠道包，支持 Android 与 iOS。以 TopOnAdvertisementManager 实现 BaseAdvertisementManager，支持横幅、插屏、激励视频与原生广告，提供完整的广告事件回调、错误处理与重试机制。TopOnAdvertisementBootstrap 在 BeforeSceneLoad 阶段自注册进 AdvertisementRegistry，注入含分平台 appId/appKey 与 adUnitId 的强类型配置；原生桥接回调由 TopOnAdvertisementBridgeLink 处理。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
